newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN'S KIRSTEN HIT WITH THREE-MATCH SUSPENSION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN'S KIRSTEN HIT WITH THREE-MATCH SUSPENSION.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen striker Ulf Kirsten, the second top scorer in the Bundesliga with seven goals, has been suspended by the German Soccer Federation (DFB) for three league matches because of a vicious foul last month.
The German international was sent off against Freiburg on September 22 for a heavy tackle on Dieter Frey.

Leverkusen, which narrowly avoided relegation last year, has made a surprisngly good start this season and are second ahead of both Bayern Munich and Dortmund following their 2-1 win over Schalke on Saturday, their fourth straight victory.
The DFB ruled on Monday that Kirsten, in addition to sitting out Leverkusen's match last Saturday, would have have to miss the next two games.
Kirsten will next be available on Oct 18 when Lverkusen play Stuttgart.
